commercial_incentive: None evident in this clip (short instructional video, no explicit sales pitch)
key_insights: Recommends applying to a total of three to five colleges overall.
Defines a safety school as one where the student's stats exceed the school's typical admitted-student criteria.
Defines a good-fit/target school as one where the student's stats fall within the school's typical criteria.
Defines a reach school as one where the student's stats fall below the school's typical criteria.
Recommends one to two safety schools and one to two good-fit/target schools, with a reach school optional.
Lists GPA, class rank, course rigor, and standardized test scores as the criteria colleges/counselors use to classify a school as safety/target/reach.
Suggests narrowing a college search by picking top two to three priority filters (location, academics, size, cost, etc.) before adding more.
notable_or_distinctive: Generic advice; a standard safety/target/reach framework presented plainly with no unusual specifics.
reliability_notes: Very short, high-level overview video with no data or sourcing; presents fairly standard, uncontroversial categorization advice.
